question: In 2025, which athlete set a new meet record of 48.81 seconds in the women’s 400 m at the Paris Diamond League?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Marileidy Paulino**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Dominican Republic** sprinter **Marileidy Paulino** set a new meet record in the **women’s 400 m** race at the **Paris Diamond League** (Meeting de Paris).
 
• She clocked an impressive time of **48.81 seconds**, which shattered the previous meet record at the **Stade Charléty**.
 
• The event took place on **July 7, 2024** (often referenced in competitive cycles for 2024-2025), serving as a crucial precursor to her performance at the **Paris Olympic Games**.
 
• By finishing with **48.81 seconds**, she finished ahead of elite competitors such as **Natalia Kaczmarek** of Poland and **Salwa Eid Naser** of Bahrain.
